canonical_domain.observations: paid/effective resources, legal availability, ordered command and hit events, physical HP AND native amount/overkill, Block, player/enemy statuses, target and card identity, zones, counters, coupled Shatter/Adamant, collateral, reset; cosmetic names and test-only origin labels erased
canonical_domain.shared_background: identical M native commands, Strength from all other sources, ordinary attacks/chips/Cracked/death/cost callbacks and unchanged prospective DD1 on both sides; never remove native Empower/Flurry from a comparator
canonical_domain.composition: Only concrete registered role interfaces may support a closed-component witness. Show the interface and full command mapping; do not relabel an arbitrary enclosing-game behaviour a closed package. Selecting roles from two contracts is not claiming the two complete historical packages are equivalent.
canonical_domain.arbitrary_history_proof: A claimed all-history equality requires a source-correspondent identity relation over common state and identical command transitions, including unavailable branches and callbacks. Finite examples alone can only refute a proposed equality.
canonical_domain.finite_projection: Python standard-library projection of the named commands. Q1 grid: upgrades 2x2, HP 2/40, target Block 0/6, facet 3/5, every partial chip 0..facet-1, background Strength 0/2, weak off/on, Adamant hold off/on. Q2 grid: upgrades 2x2, HP 2/40, Block 0/6/40, background Strength 0/2, weak and Cracked off/on. Dedicated controls cover target/copy, absent/off/other-aspect, repeated consumers, wrong order, resource denial, native amount, Thorns/death, deferred settlement and reset. No RNG population is sampled.
canonical_domain.finite_cap: At most 20000 constructed comparison cells, plus small named controls. No enlarged search after a decisive witness. No old 69-check or accepted Crosscut suite replay.

decision_rule: Complete both route decisions from the source arguments plus relevant falsification evidence: supported source eligibility pending native qualification, exact-clause source exclusion, or genuine unresolved with the smallest remaining relation. Mere absence of a counterexample is not eligibility. After exclusion, skip dependent peer/exporter/readiness work and finish the other route. If both survive, check same-product source composition with unchanged DD1.
